name: ways-of-working
description: A delivery method for Claude Code, built on Matt Pocock's skills.

plugins.name: ways
plugins.description: The operating model around Matt Pocock's skills (installed with it): repo setup, working an issue interactively or autonomously, the autonomous gate, and merge policy by risk.

plugins.name: ways-band
plugins.description: A mod: a status band above the prompt (mode, issue, last gate result, merge dial, context use) and /gate to run the gate instantly. Optional, and a small worked example of a mod.

plugins.name: ways-qa
plugins.description: QA skills on top of ways, for testers working against a running app with Playwright: /ways-qa:setup (the QA repo's own setup), /ways-qa:triage (duplicates, regressions, severity, routing, evidence, stated confidence) and /ways-qa:reproduce (a report to a Playwright test that fails for the right reason). Installs ways and the Playwright plugin with it.
